title: Why does AI sometimes make up answers?
dek: Language models predict the next word, they do not check facts. Here is how the mechanism works, and when you should be careful.

title: Mistral Large 4, the trillion-parameter bet from Europe
dek: Announced on October 6, 2026, this 1-trillion-parameter model is promised with open weights by month's end. What is certain and what is still a promise, separated.

title: When are AI tools actually useful? (and when not)
dek: AI tools shine at specific, well-defined tasks. For vague high-stakes decisions, they are brainstorming partners, not judges.

title: Why DNS only has 13 root servers
dek: The global DNS system is constrained to 13 logical root servers, and the reason comes down to a packet size limit set in the 1980s.
